meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动管理 Benchling 平台上的实验室数据录入与查询
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的实验室用 Benchling 管理研发数据,想自动同步和查询。
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data entry and queries on Benchling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your lab uses Benchling and needs automated data entry and lookup.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能按技能手册用 Benchling Python SDK 或 v2 API 协助你操作 Benchling:管理 DNA/RNA/蛋白等实体、库存容器、电子实验记录与工作流,并可指导数据仓库查询。需已配好租户地址与 API key。
howto.when: 当你要求用 Benchling Python SDK 或 v2 API 自动化实验数据(例如管理序列、库存、电子实验记录等)时触发;需已配置租户 URL 与 API key。

say.note: 会给出容器转移操作步骤。

say.text: 查一下 Benchling 数据仓库上周样本数。

howto.what_en: Installation lets Claude use the Benchling Python SDK/v2 API to manage registered entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, and Data Warehouse queries. Requires tenant URL and API key.
howto.when_en: Trigger when the user wants to automate Benchling lab data with the Python SDK or v2 API—for example, managing sequences, inventory, or ELN entries. Requires a configured tenant URL and API key.

say_en.text: Create and register a DNA plasmid named GFP with sequence ATCG in Benchling.
Move Benchling inventory tube Sample 1 to a new box.
Query Benchling Data Warehouse for last week's sample count.
